content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available – 2 for Project Associate I (PAT-I) and 1 for Project Associate II (PAT-II).

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Associate I (PAT-I) - FBR020402-01: Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Food Science & Technology OR M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology from recognised university. Project Associate I (PAT-I) - FBR020402-02: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Information Science/Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning (AI&ML)/Data Science Engineering or Technology OR Master of Computer Applications OR M.Sc. in Computer Science from recognised university. Project Associate II (PAT-II) - FBR020402-03: M. Tech. in Food Technology / Food Processing Technology/ Food safety and quality management OR M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology / Food Science /Food Technology / Food Science and Nutrition / Food Processing Technology from recognised university AND 2 years of experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Age Relaxation: SC/ST/PwBD/Women: 05 years OBC: 03 years

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Associate I (PAT-I): Rs. 25,000/- plus HRA Project Associate II (PAT-II): Rs. 28,000/- plus HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CSIR CFTRI Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CSIR CFTRI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CFTRI Project Associate positions?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate positions at CSIR CFTRI is 12th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Associates at CSIR CFTRI?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for Project Associate positions, including Project Associate – I and Project Associate – II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: For Project Associate – I, candidates need a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology in Food Science & Technology, or an M.Sc. in Food Science and Technology.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for Project Associate – II?
faq.answer: Yes, for Project Associate – II, candidates require a Master's degree (M.Tech. or M.Sc.) in a relevant field along with 2 years of experience in Research and Development.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Project Associate posts is 35 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any age relaxations for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years over and above the maximum age limit.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Project Associate – I?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate – I is Rs. 25,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Project Associate – II?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate – II is Rs. 28,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications by a designated committee, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the CSIR CFTRI Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply online through the official CSIR CFTRI website or the provided application link before the last date.
